description: This file provides type definitions and documentation for the Node.js 'sea' module, which supports running Node.js applications as single-executable binaries with embedded assets. It describes functions for detecting if running inside such an application, retrieving assets, and listing embedded asset keys, along with detailed comments on the process of creating such single-executable files.

methods.name: function isSea(): boolean; isSea
methods.description: Returns whether the current script is running inside a single-executable application.

methods.name: getAsset
methods.description: Retrieves the asset associated with the provided key, optionally decoding it with the specified encoding.

methods.name: getAssetAsBlob
methods.description: Retrieves the asset as a Blob object, with optional type specification.

methods.name: function getRawAsset(key: AssetKey): ArrayBuffer; getRawAsset
methods.description: Retrieves the raw asset as an ArrayBuffer, returning the embedded data directly.

methods.name: getAssetKeys
methods.description: Returns an array of all embedded asset keys, applicable only when running inside a single-executable application.
